newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile November supermarket sales rise slightly.
newsitem.headline: Chile November supermarket sales rise slightly.

text.p: Chilean supermarket sales grew 1.1 percent last month compared with November last year, said the Association of Chilean Supermarkets.
The figures showed sales growth picking up slightly from October when sales fell 0.4 percent on the same month in 1995.
November's figure brings the growth in supermarket sales in the first 11 months of the year to 6.2 percent, said the statement.
Chileans are among Latin America's most enthusiastic supermarket shoppers with supermarket sales widely regarded as a rough guide to consumer spending.
